concept.observed: A 15 s motion reel: dot and 'eyes', Bauhaus shape grid, blue field, tilted panel and push into a 3D chrome sphere, then TYPE./SPACE./TIME. cards and a closing title with a swoosh.
concept.interpreted: A showreel structured as a tour of motion disciplines (shape, depth, type, time).

communication_style.observed: No narration; words as chapter labels.

palette.interpreted: Black, cream and electric blue with an orange signal colour.

typography.observed: Heavy sans caps with full stops; outline and metallic variants of the same word style; italic serif accent word on a tilted panel.

composition.observed: Grid of primitives filling the frame; centred words; persistent corner frame.

shapes_and_materials.observed: Flat circles, quarter circles, squares and bars; one chrome sphere with an orange ring (3D).

motion.observed: Staggered pops into a grid; a rectangle grows to fill the frame; push through a word; smeared word entrances.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Measured median shot 2.48 s; word cards 0.33 s apart at 10.52-11.17 s.

transitions.observed: Re-read 2026-11-27: 6 boundaries (2 cut, 3 grow, 1 cover, 0 continuous). 2.48 s grow: the right ring 'eye' fills cream and blooms past the frame edges in about 0.13 s (2.42-2.56 s); its cream is the next background and the grid shapes pop in at once. 4.82 s grow: a small blue rectangle scales up to fill the frame in about 0.3 s (4.66-4.96 s) and becomes the blue field. 7.70 s grow: zoom through the word: it scales up past the lens (7.54-7.67 s) and the chrome sphere is behind it. 10.52 s cover: an orange diagonal wipe crosses the 3D scene (edge at 10.36 s), solid orange holds about 0.13 s, then the first word card smears in from the side (10.53-10.62 s). 10.85 s cut: hard cut between one-word cards; the new word enters with a short horizontal smear. 11.17 s cut: hard cut to the third word card (cream to black). Earlier reading (2026-10-30): Eye-to-disc bloom (2.48 s), shape grows to background (4.82 s), push through text (7.70 s), diagonal wipe with smear (10.52 s), hard cuts.
transitions.interpreted: Every section turn is made from an element of the outgoing frame (an eye, a rectangle, a word); plain cuts are kept for the word list.

depth_and_layering.observed: Flat until a perspective tilt and a 3D sphere section (about 6-10 s).

camera.observed: Simulated camera push into a scene at 7.70 s.

audio_and_sync.observed: 7.4 onsets/s, tempo estimate 123 bpm (medium); 83% of boundaries within 50 ms of an onset (chance 52%; analyzer 1.2).
audio_and_sync.interpreted: Loosely synced to a busy track; the high onset rate makes chance alignment high.

motifs.observed: Dots and rings; full stops; the corner frame.

sound_design.observed: Integrated -23.9 LUFS, LRA 3.9 LU, true peak -7.5 dBTP (a quiet master). Tempo estimate 123 bpm (medium). 25 accents (100 a minute) on a near-regular 0.48-0.49 s grid (0.53, 1.02, 1.51, 2.00, 2.48, 2.95 s). Accents on cuts 0.50 against chance 0.28 (6 boundaries); onsets near boundaries 0.83 against 0.52. One silence 14.61-15.02 s (the end); head -9.8 dB and tail -14.8 dB against the body. On the listen sheet every accent brings one event: the dot appears (0.53 s), the line draws (1.02 s), the word settles (1.51 s), its O fills (2.00 s), a circle blooms to cover the frame (2.48 s), grid tiles flip (2.95-4.41 s), a blue panel covers the frame (4.90 s).
sound_design.interpreted: A beat-grid reel: one visual event per beat, and the cuts sit on beats too (above chance). Much quieter than the -14 LUFS promos.

narration.observed: None: dictation found 0 words in 15 s.

captions.observed: None; copy is the picture: one centred heavy-caps word per card and an italic serif accent word on a tilted panel; no caption lane.

Cream: geometric primitives pop into a grid and rearrange.
